title: How do data owners say no? A case study of data consent mechanisms in web-scraped vision-language AI training datasets
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not conduct any measurements related to faith or religion. Its focus is on data consent mechanisms, copyright notices, and terms of service in web-scraped vision-language datasets.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. The research is focused on data consent, copyright, and terms of service for the DataComp dataset.
